title: Administrative path threat synthesis and remediation plan for RBAC v2, SSO & audit
creator: Avery Clarke
description: Consolidate penetration-test and internal threat-model findings across RBAC v2, SSO/SAML flows, and audit logging to produce a prioritized remediation plan for administrative surfaces. Deliverables: (1) concise threat synthesis, (2) specific fixes and rollouts for RBAC policy evaluation paths and privileged session handling, (3) audit-log schema changes and retention adjustments, and (4) verification tests and monitoring dashboard queries to detect regressions. This ticket coordinates engineering, product, and security to close the highest-risk gaps discovered during the Feb 2026 external pen-test and follow-up internal review.
updates: 2026-02-20: Ticket created by Avery Clarke; initial triage call scheduled with SecEng and Platform on 2026-02-22.

2026-02-22: Triage notes added. Agreed scope: admin API surfaces, RBAC v2 evaluation order, SAML assertion replay handling, and audit log provenance. Assigned owners for each scope: Priya (RBAC), Miguel (SSO), Samira (Audit).

2026-02-27: Received external pen-test report (RedTeamCo) - summarized 9 findings: 2 high (privileged role escalation via ambiguous role inheritance, insufficient audit linkage), 4 medium (session fixation on admin portal, missing SAML audience checks, rate-limit bypass), 3 low (log rotation gaps, non-atomic role updates, ambiguous error messages). Stored full report in Confluence.

2026-03-02: Ran threat-modeling workshop with Product and Platform (artifact: Confluence /spaces/SEC/pages/ARM-2026-02-threat-synthesis). Produced attack trees for three principal vectors: role evaluation race, SAML assertion misuse, audit log tampering. Assigned risk scores and recommended mitigations.

2026-03-05: Engineering spike completed - reproduced role inheritance edge case in unit tests. Root cause: RBAC v2 evaluator uses depth-first inheritance resolution which allowed a temporary policy state to be applied during concurrent role updates (race window ~50-120ms under load). Patch candidate prepared in PR #1985.

2026-03-08: Initial remediation plan reviewed by Security and Product. Decision: prefer deterministic policy reconciliation (CRDT-style merge) for RBAC v2 rather than naive locking to reduce latency impact. Trade-offs discussed: increased implementation complexity vs long-term correctness and reduced operational load.

2026-03-10: External pen-test follow-up call. RedTeamCo validated reproduction steps for SAML audience missing check; provided PoC. Agreed mitigation deadline for high issues = 2026-03-31. RedTeamCo will re-test after fixes are staged.

2026-03-12: PRs opened: GH#1985 (rbac: deterministic reconciliation patch), GH#1992 (admin-portal: session fixation mitigation), GH#1999 (audit: append-only envelope + event-hash linkage). Added integration test plan and instrumentation queries for console dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: RBAC v2 deterministic reconciliation implemented and covered by unit + concurrency tests reproducing previous race window failure
SSO/SAML: audience and destination checks present in assertion validation, replay nonce recorded and rejected; automated test harness exercising assertion replay PoC
Audit logging: append-only envelope with event-hash linking enabled for admin APIs; logs include immutable request_id, actor_id, previous_role_snapshot where applicable
All high and medium pen-test findings marked resolved or remediated with mitigation documented; RedTeamCo verification scheduled
Console dashboards updated with alerts for suspicious admin activity (failed SAML assertions, rapid role changes, audit gaps) and runbook added to PagerDuty escalation
mitigation_plan: RBAC v2: Replace depth-first evaluator with deterministic reconciliation algorithm. Implement optimistic concurrency with conflict resolution and add audit hooks to record before/after role snapshots.
SSO/SAML: Add mandatory audience and destination checks in the SAML consumer. Introduce short-lived replay nonces stored in HSM-backed KV store; reject duplicates and log with high-fidelity context.

Admin sessions: Harden admin portal session cookies (SameSite=Strict, HttpOnly, secure), implement rotating session IDs on privilege elevation, and add server-side session binding to TLS client cert fingerprint for critical ops.

Audit logging: Transition critical admin endpoints to append-only envelopes in the logging pipeline; include event-hash chain and sign batches with KMS key. Increase retention for admin logs to 1 year for compliance review.
Operational: Create SLOs and alerts for rapid role churn, failed assertion rate >0.1%, and audit pipeline lag >5s. Update runbooks for incident response and for escalation to SecEng.
testing_plan: Unit tests for deterministic reconciliation covering ancestry graphs with 0-20 roles and concurrent update scenarios (simulate 1000 ops/s).
Integration tests: end-to-end SAML assertion flows including malformed audience, replayed assertion PoC, clock skew boundary tests.
Pen-test verification: schedule re-test with RedTeamCo after staging deploy; include both whitebox and blackbox validation of fixes.
Audit verification: synthetic workload generator to produce admin events; validate event-hash chain integrity and KMS signatures; run corruption/rollover tests on rotated storage nodes.
Load test: apply production-equivalent role-change churn and measure latency rollback window; ensure changes meet throughput SLOs with <5% p99 latency regression.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): Deploy RBAC reconcile and SAML fixes behind feature flags in staging cluster. Smoke tests and synthetic audits run for 48 hours. (Owner: Priya)
Phase 2 (canary): Enable feature flags for 5% of admin traffic in canary region with enhanced logging. Monitor dashboard for anomalies for 72 hours. (Owner: Miguel)
Phase 3 (gradual): Ramp canary to 25%, then 100% if metrics stable. Schedule blackout window of 30 minutes for safe rollback if P0 alerts fire. (Owners: Platform Ops)
Phase 4 (post-deploy): Run RedTeamCo re-test and internal audit; mark external validation complete before closing ticket.
verification_checks: Synthetic assertion replay PoC returns 403 and is logged with 'saml.replay_detected' tag
Concurrent role update test no longer produces transient privilege elevation in 100k simulated operations
Audit event-hash chain verified across three storage nodes and KMS signature verified
Dashboard alerts fire for injected anomalies and PagerDuty runbook correctly routes to SecEng on call
